payload.reason: The evidence provides various existing approaches for representing geographic locations using embeddings, including methods that integrate textual descriptions, structured data, and word embeddings.

claims.text: One approach uses principal component analysis and stacked autoencoders to learn low-dimensional vector representations of city neighborhoods based on census data, improving predictions of attributes like crime.
Another method combines Flickr tags with numerical and categorical information to learn geographic location embeddings, showing improved prediction performance over baseline methods.
Some existing works utilize word embedding models to learn representations of Points-of-Interest (POIs) based on user visit sequences, treating locations as words in a sentence.
